mission: Allow a DreamCo bot to use Buddy's Stripe-backed live payment path only after technical, business, payment, safety and owner-authorization gates pass.
required_gates: sellable capability is verified by runtime evidence
$1000 revenue experiment has a measured sandbox result
no release-blocking build or deployment failure
owner explicitly enables live monetization for that bot/offer

live_actions.create_live_checkout: approval required until bot+offer is explicitly enabled
live_actions.charge: never direct raw-card charge by bot; use Stripe-hosted/tokenized payment flows
live_actions.refund: explicit approval unless owner establishes bounded refund automation policy

suspension_triggers: offer no longer matches verified capability
truth_rule: Passing tests can make a bot eligible for live monetization, but it does not authorize spending, outreach, contracts, refunds, payouts or charges beyond the owner's configured live permissions. Revenue is recorded only from verified Stripe events, never from forecasts or simulations.
